front.title: POC for CVE-2025-11058: Arbitrary File Read via PDF Generation

abstract.t: This document is a proof of concept demonstrating CVE-2025-11058, an arbitrary file read vulnerability in xml2rfc versions <= 3.30.0. When this XML is converted to PDF using the vulnerable version, the /etc/passwd file will be read and included as an attachment in the PDF.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: This proof of concept demonstrates a critical security vulnerability in xml2rfc that allows arbitrary file reading through malicious link elements with rel="attachment" attribute.

section.name: Vulnerability Details
section.t: The vulnerability exists in the PDF generation process where link elements are not properly validated. An attacker can inject a link element with rel="attachment" pointing to sensitive files on the filesystem.

section.name: Exploitation
section.t: To test this vulnerability on an affected system:

ol.li: Extract attachments from the generated PDF using: pdfdetach -saveall output.pdf
The contents of /etc/passwd will be in the extracted files

front.title: xml2rfc has an arbitrary file read vulnerability
